      IPO disclosures shows Coca-Cola has significant veto powers over partner Jubilant

      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 1:23
      Instaread
      The Coca-Cola company, among other special rights, has a right to veto investors to whom Jubilant can sell its shares
      Pavan Burugula & Akshara Srivastava
      November 12, 2026 / 15:00 IST
      Besides restrictions on exit, there are also many clauses within the agreement which require Jubilant to follow HCCOH when it comes to governance matters, board dynamics, and executive selection
      • HCCOH filed DRHP for an IPO worth up to Rs 9,000 crore.
      • Agreement grants Coca-Cola major governance rights over Jubilant.
      • Jubilant faces a 5-year lock-in and strict share sale rules.
